description: A script that detects if the environment is a Continuous Integration (CI) environment, and directs to either serve a static build or start a development server accordingly. It involves setting environment variables and invoking npm scripts to manage the server process.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Detects if the current environment is a CI environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously with the given arguments and environment, then exits with the command's status.
